summary: The retained evidence supports withholding X order, revenue and profit credit. Both retained order records satisfy every supplied eligibility flag, but neither supplies a recorded X signal. One journey contains one returned direct-visit moment without UTM/referrer evidence; the other is ready with zero visit moments. Unrecorded attribution remains unknown. The calendar sales total cannot be assigned to X or treated as profit, and its scope is not reconciled to the exact order-creation window. No correction is required to the decision or its stated limits.

independence.evidence_level: Independent consistency review of frozen root-supplied schema validation, server readback and privacy-reduced classifications; not a new live source.

checks.method: Local Python JSON, SHA-256, UTC-date, Decimal arithmetic and explicit field/predicate checks.

results.check: Final source hash matches; both ShopifyQL reports and reduced order readback name the same expected shop.
Order search uses inclusive exact launch/cutoff timestamps; current-day sessions and September 11-14 calendar sales are explicitly separate scopes.
Read-only query selects the order eligibility, journey, source/referrer/landing-UTM and pagination fields needed for the stated reduction; root validation is VALID and root readback has no errors.

Two retained rows equal reported order count, reported distinct count and eligible count; both rows have all five inclusion flags true. Distinct IDs themselves were not retained for independent deduplication.
Outer and both moment hasNextPage flags are false; retained moment arrays match counts of one and zero. This does not prove complete attribution capture.
Boundary-inclusive observations equal moment count plus present first/last fields: three and zero. Source explicitly excludes interpreting these as unique acquired visitors.
All retained X classifiers and per-order signals are false/zero; boundary visits are classified Direct without UTM/referrer, and the sole retained moment has no pilot landing UTM.
Both journeys are present and ready, but the second has no visits; attribution decision explicitly preserves unknown unrecorded sources and rejects a zero-buyers inference.
Sessions report contains no rows/columns; sales rows sum to two orders and displayed total_sales 152.78. Source expressly declines amount/order reconciliation across scopes.
Retained order records contain no raw order IDs, customer identity, full URLs, exact order timestamps, line items or amounts. No such values were reproduced in this review.
Decision assigns neither order/revenue/profit to X, leaves goal unachieved and overall outcome partial, requires actual costs before success, and preserves other sales clocks.
All source mutation counters are zero; unchanged publisher question is not repeated, and identical reports/journeys are not scheduled for an immediate repeat absent changed evidence.

inclusion_and_count_review.filter_application: GraphQL search filters creation time. PAID, non-test, noncancelled and web eligibility are represented by the root's post-read reduction of fields selected by the query; they are not server-side search clauses.
inclusion_and_count_review.scope_limit: Creation-window candidates are not a payment-time or full-sales reconciliation. A matching aggregate count does not prove the two report populations are identical.

decision_review.reason: No retained positive X evidence supports either order, and actual costs were not selected. Missing signals and a Direct label cannot establish that X played no role. Calendar total_sales is not attributed contribution.
decision_review.adversarial_challenge: Ready journeys and exhausted cursors can look complete while source capture is missing. Treating them as proof of no X influence, or counting first/last repeats as extra buyers, would overstate the evidence.
decision_review.credible_alternative: Reopen this branch only when a new order, changed journey data or a permitted X receipt provides decision-changing evidence; then reconcile QA and actual costs before assigning credit.

limitations: Schema discovery, validation success and server responses are root-supplied; the reviewer made no independent live request.

Discarded IDs and raw fields prevent independent re-derivation of distinct-ID count, source-is-web/date/financial predicates and the X-normalization classifier. This review verifies retained arithmetic and decision consistency, not the original reducer implementation.
First/last-to-moment identity is not independently established from the reduced record. Three observations are explicitly diagnostic and are not promoted to three visits or buyers.
False pagination flags prove no next page was reported for the selected connections; ready status and empty visits do not prove all acquisition touchpoints were captured.
The partial-day sessions report has no rows, not proven zero activity. Sales report currency, amounts-to-order reconciliation and actual costs are not established here.
Root-reported disposal of transient private values was not independently audited; the retained artifact itself contains no such order/customer values.
Root command receipts, media-origin inspection, runtime goal administration and future X execution are outside this bounded attribution review.
next_action: Root may index this review and retain unknown X attribution/profit; reopen the candidate-order branch only upon new permitted evidence, while preserving the existing publisher gate and uncertain post states.
